name: GenQA
intro: GenQA 不是独立数据集或论文，而是 OLMo 3 报告与官方 OLMES 配置中 OlmoBaseEval 的九任务宏平均能力组，聚合排序选择/续写与生成式短答案问答。
build_method: 模型排名聚类, 任务格式对齐, 官方九任务套件聚合
task_type: 基础模型问答聚合, 排序选择与短答案生成
eval_feature: 九任务宏平均, 任务级few-shot协议, 准确率与答案库F1
task_type_en: Aggregated Base-model QA, Rank-choice and Short-answer Generation
build_method_en: Model-ranking Clustering, Task-format Alignment, Official Nine-task Suite Aggregation
eval_feature_en: Nine-task Macro Average, Task-specific Few-shot Protocols, Accuracy and Answer-bank F1
intro_en: GenQA is not a standalone dataset or paper. It is the nine-task macro-averaged OlmoBaseEval capability group defined in the OLMo 3 report and official OLMES configuration, aggregating rank-choice/continuation and generative short-answer QA.
scale_en: Nine tasks; BasicSkills contains six subtasks

drawio_review_note: Verified against arXiv:2512.13961v2 (Section 3.3.1, Table 46, Appendix A.4.2) and allenai/olmes at commit 5a51f502d463b8cdc4a2dcad7d7096c41ff1197e (oe_eval/configs/task_suites.py entries olmo3:base:gen and basic_skills:rc::olmes, plus oe_eval/configs/tasks.py). GenQA is not a standalone dataset: OLMo 3 clusters about 23K benchmark scores from 70 open-weight models with Ward linkage, aligns clusters with task format, and defines the nine-entry macro HellaSwag, WinoGrande, LAMBADA, BasicSkills, DROP, Jeopardy, NaturalQs, SQuAD, and CoQA; BasicSkills is itself a six-task nested macro. Rank-choice or continuation entries use their configured accuracy variants, while generated short answers use F1 against answer banks. Most entries are 5-shot; LAMBADA is 0-shot, CoQA uses zero outer shots with task context, and generation uses temperature 0, no sampling, top-p 1, and 100 tokens for DROP or 50 for the other generated tasks. Incomplete answer banks can create false negatives; Gen2MC is a separate analysis and is not part of GenQA.
